summary: W. P. Carey Inc. filed an 8-K on June 29, 2026, reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $350 million in 5.200% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes were priced at par with no conversion or equity component. Proceeds will repay existing 4.250% notes due October 2026 and other corporate uses. The offering is a routine debt refinancing under an existing shelf registration, not related to M&A, activist, or restructuring. Therefore, this filing does not constitute a special-situation event. What to watch: monitoring the company's leverage and credit rating post-refinancing.
